findings.proposed_change:
Extract a new shared lemma into a lower-level Jets file importing DifferentialConstant, NormalFrameBasis, and PolynomialTangentDifferential. Its proposed statement, in namespace OAI.PiExponent with Module, MvPolynomial, and NormalBasisRigidity open, is:

lemma constant_of_polynomial_normal_separation
    {C E : Type*} [Field C] [CharZero C] [IsAlgClosed C]
    [Field E] [Algebra C E] [Algebra.EssFiniteType C E] {m : ℕ}
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) C →ₐ[C] E)
    (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) C))
    (hvan : ∀ p ∈ Q, φ p = 0)
    (hy : φ (X (0 : Fin (m + 1))) ≠ 0)
    (hq : (polynomialTangent φ Q).mkQ ≠ 0)
    (hexclude : ∀ A B : Finset (Fin (m + 1)),
      IsNormalBasis (K := E)
        (fun j => (polynomialTangent φ Q).mkQ (Pi.basisFun E _ j)) A →
      IsNormalBasis (K := E)
        (fun j => (polynomialTangent φ Q).mkQ
          (frameBasis m (φ (X 0)) hy j)) B →
      ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → i ∈ A → i ∉ B →
      (∀ j, i < j → (j ∈ A ↔ j ∈ B)) → False) :
    ∃ c : C, algebraMap C E c = φ (X (0 : Fin (m + 1)))

Proof sketch: apply normal_basis_differential_dichotomy with mkQ_surjective and hq. Convert tangent membership to quotient vanishing using Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero. In the first case apply differential_eq_zero_of_polynomialTangent and constant_of_differential_eq_zero; in the second apply logarithmic_differential_of_polynomialTangent and constant_of_logarithmic_differential.

Import the new file in the target. Its proof becomes:

  letI : Algebra.EssFiniteType C (PolynomialResidueField Q) :=
    polynomialResidueField_essFiniteType Q
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := constant_of_polynomial_normal_separation
    (polynomialResidueMap Q) Q (polynomialResidueMap_eq_zero Q)
    hy hq hexclude
  exact ⟨c, coordinate_sub_constant_mem_prime Q 0 c hc⟩

GenericNormalRigidity already imports the target and therefore receives the new lemma transitively. Rewrite its proof as:

  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := constant_of_polynomial_normal_separation φ Q
    (fun p hp => (hker p).mpr hp) hy
    (polynomialNormal_mkQ_ne_zero_of_kernel φ Q hker hQ) hexclude
  refine ⟨c, (hker _).mp ?_⟩
  simp only [map_sub, MvPolynomial.algHom_C, hc, sub_self]

This extracts the shared argument rather than treating the downstream theorem as an independently available replacement. Retain hy and hq; no extra positivity or m > 0 assumption is needed. For m = 0, the existential Fin m branch is empty and the original dichotomy still applies.
findings.benefit: Centralizes the basis-exclusion-to-constancy argument while leaving residue-field setup and ideal-membership conversion at their respective call sites. Changes to the differential bridge then require maintaining one proof rather than two.
